strings: Is happy to be healthy again
Is missing being pampered in the medicine den
Is happy to no longer be {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} own patient
Wonders if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} should take another moon to rest and recover, just to be safe
Stays in the medicine den an extra night to be sure {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} completely recovered
